                I feel like AI memory investing is simpler than what people expect.

Because $MU + Sanjay (CEO) literally tells everyone what’s coming.

But somehow. Almost every. single. time. Markets dismiss it until it actually happens?

Be $MU in 2025: Expands HBM3e and DRAM capacity, locks in hyperscaler contracts.

Markets dismissing it: “Memory cycle is dead! DRAM is commoditized! NAND oversupply will crush margins!”

1 year later:
$MU +240%,
$WDC +195%,
$SNDK +591%,
$AMAT +97%.

Micron in 2026:

Commits billions to HBM4 fabs, announces LTAs with $NVDA adm $AMD, signals AI inference demand exploding. Explicit about CXL memory pooling. States “AI memory is the backbone of Physical AI.”

Markets now: “HBM is overhyped! CXL adoption is years away! AI memory margins won’t last!”

Yeah… We’ll see what happens in 2027.

I think I’m putting my money on Sanjay/Micron as the leading indicator.
